rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The commanded contracts are binding covenants made with God and with other people.
rows.anchor: يعني: بالعهود المؤكدة التي عاهدتموها مع الله والناس

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One interpretation identifies the permitted livestock as camels, cattle, and sheep themselves.
rows.anchor: قيل: هي الأنعام نفسها، وهي الإبل والبقر والغنم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation includes wild game such as gazelles, wild cattle, and wild asses among the livestock.
rows.anchor: وقيل: بهيمة الأنعام: وحشيها كالظباء، وبقر الوحش، وحمر الوحش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception for what is recited refers to the Qur'anic prohibition beginning with carrion.
rows.anchor: يعني: قوله: حرمت عليكم الميتة... الآية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hunting is forbidden while one is in the state of consecration.
rows.anchor: إلا أن تحلوا الصيد في حال الإحرام؛ فإنه لا يحل لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God permits and prohibits whatever He wills.
rows.anchor: يحل ما يشاء، ويحرم ما يشاء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's rites here mean sacrificial offerings marked for slaughter at Mecca.
rows.anchor: يعني: الهدايا المعلمة للذبح بمكة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse was revealed concerning al-Ḥuṭam ibn Ḍubayʿa after he raided Medina's grazing herd and took it to al-Yamama.
rows.anchor: نزلت هذه الآية في الحطم [بن ضبيعة] أغار على سرح المدينة، فذهب به إلى اليمامة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the Prophet heard al-Yamama pilgrims' talbiya on the year of the make-up pilgrimage, he identified al-Ḥuṭam and urged pursuit.
rows.anchor: فلما خرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عام القضية سمع تلبية حجاج اليمامة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ḥuṭam had marked the plundered Medina herd and dedicated it to the Kaaba.
rows.anchor: وكان قد قلد ما نهب من سرح المدينة، وأهداه إلى الكعبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sacred month must not be violated by fighting.
rows.anchor: ولا الشهر الحرام } بالقتال فيه { ولا الهدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hady comprises every camel, cow, or sheep offered to God's House.
rows.anchor: وهي كل ما أهدي إلى بيت الله من ناقة، وبقرة وشاة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The garlands are offerings adorned with bark from trees of the sanctuary.
rows.anchor: يعني: الهدايا المقلدة من لحاء شجر الحرم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those heading to the Sacred House include polytheist pilgrims.
rows.anchor: ولا آمين البيت الحرام } قاصديه من المشركين

rows.speaker: المفسرون
rows.claim: In pre-Islamic custom, Arabs fought except in sacred months, while marked sacrificial animals, pilgrims driving offerings, people marked with sanctuary bark, and those in ihram were left unharmed.
rows.anchor: كانت الحرب في الجاهلية قائمة بين العرب إلا في الأشهر الحرم، فمن وجد في غيرها أصيب منه

rows.speaker: المفسرون
rows.claim: God ordered Muslims to preserve this security for a beneficial purpose until the command to kill polytheists wherever found abrogated it.
rows.anchor: فأمر الله سبحانه تعالى المسلمين بإقرار هذه الأمنة على ما كانت لضرب من المصلحة إلى أن نسخها بقوله تعالى: فاقتلوا المشركين حيث وجدتموهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pilgrims sought trade profit and, as they claimed, God's favor through pilgrimage.
rows.anchor: يبتغون فضلا من ربهم } أي: ربحا بالتجارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After leaving ihram, the command to hunt grants permission.
rows.anchor: وإذا حللتم } من الإحرام { فاصطادوا } أمر إباحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Animosity toward Meccans who barred the Muslims at Hudaybiyya must not lead to aggression.
rows.anchor: شنآن قوم } بغض قوم، يعني: أهل مكة { أن صدوكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibited aggression would include attacking al-Yamama pilgrims and treating their inviolable status as lawful to violate.
rows.anchor: أن تعتدوا } على حجاج اليمامة، فتستحلوا منهم محرما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cooperating in righteousness means helping one another do what God commanded.
rows.anchor: وتعاونوا } ليعن بعضكم بعضا { على البر } وهو ما أمرت به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taqwa is refraining from what God has forbidden.
rows.anchor: والتقوى } ترك ما نهيت عنه { ولا تعاونوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sin means disobedience to God, and aggression means transgressing His limits.
rows.anchor: ولا تعاونوا على الإثم } يعني: معاصي الله { والعدوان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear God by not making the inviolable lawful; His punishment is severe when He punishes.
rows.anchor: واتقوا الله } فلا تستحلوا محرما { إن الله شديد العقاب } إذا عاقب

rows.speaker: عدي بن حاتم
rows.claim: Adi ibn Hatim asked the Prophet what hunting with dogs and falcons made lawful, since carrion was forbidden; this occasioned the verse.
rows.anchor: سأل عدي بن حاتم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: إنا نصيد بالكلاب والبزاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good things means what Arabs regard as wholesome; this is the basic rule for determining lawful food.
rows.anchor: يعين: ما تستطيبه العرب، وهذا هو الأصل في التحليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Animals Arabs find wholesome, including monitor lizards, jerboas, and rabbits, are lawful, while what they find repugnant is forbidden.
rows.anchor: فكل حيوان استطابته العرب، كالضباب، واليرابيع، والأرانب فهو حلال، وما استخبثته العرب فهو حرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The trained hunting creatures are catchers among birds, dogs, and predatory beasts.
rows.anchor: وهي الكواسب من الطير والكلاب والسباع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mukallibin describes training the hunting animals to hunt.
rows.anchor: مكلبين } معلمين إياها الصيد { تعلمونهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Teaching the animals means disciplining them to pursue prey.
rows.anchor: تؤدبوهن لطلب الصيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One may eat prey the trained animal kills if it does not eat from it; if it eats from the prey, it is apparently forbidden.
rows.anchor: وإن قتلن إذا لم يأكلن منه، فإذا أكلن فالظاهر أنه حرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's name is mentioned when the hunting animals are released.
rows.anchor: واذكروا اسم الله عليه } عند إرسال الجوارح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question answers the Jews' claim that they knew no people with a worse religion than the Muslims they were criticizing.
rows.anchor: جواب لقول اليهود: ما نعرف أهل دين شرا منكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people worse in recompense are those God cursed, meaning He drove them away from His mercy.
rows.anchor: من لعنه الله } أي: هو من لعنه الله: أبعده عن رحمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people transformed into apes and pigs were the Sabbath-breakers.
rows.anchor: وجعل منهم القردة والخنازير } يعني: أصحاب السبت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about serving ṭāghūt is coordinated grammatically with the curse, and means obeying Satan in what he prompted.
rows.anchor: نسق على { لعنه الله } وعبد الطاغوت:] أطاع الشيطان فيما سوله له.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their place is worse because it is Saqar, and their greater error is departure from the straight path of ḥanīfiyya.
rows.anchor: أضل عن سواء السبيل } قصد الطريق، وهو دين الحنيفية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the verse came down, Muslims taunted the Jews as brothers of apes and pigs; the Jews fell silent and were exposed.
rows.anchor: فلما نزلت هذه الآية عير المسلمون اليهود، وقالوا: يا إخوان القردة والخنازير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who say they believe when they come are Jewish hypocrites.
rows.anchor: يعني: منافقي اليهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They enter and leave as unbelievers, with unbelief accompanying them in both states.
rows.anchor: أي: دخلوا وخرجوا كافرين، والكفر معهم في كلتي حالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person in ihram may not kill game or even approach it in any way while consecrated.
rows.anchor: حرم الله قتل الصيد على المحرم، فليس له أن يتعرض للصيد بوجه من الوجوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The livestock compensation must resemble the killed animal in physical form: an ostrich requires a camel, a wild ass a cow, and a hyena a ram.
rows.anchor: ففي النعامة بدنة، وفي حمار الوحش بقرة، وفي الضبع كبش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Two upright men from the offenders' religious community judge the game compensation and select the closest livestock resemblance.
rows.anchor: يحكم في الصيد بالجزاء رجلان صالحان { منكم } من أهل [ملتكم]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The offering reaches Mecca, where it is slaughtered and given in charity.
rows.anchor: إذا أتى مكة ذبحه، وتصدق به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The offender may choose equivalent livestock, food, or fasting: value the equivalent in dirhams and food, give it in charity, or fast one day per mudd.
rows.anchor: والمحرم إذا قتل صيدا كان مخيرا؛ إن شاء جزاه بمثله من النعم؛ وإن شاء قوم المثل دراهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about God having pardoned what is past concerns killings before the prohibition.
rows.anchor: عفا الله عما سلف } قبل التحريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A repeat offender is judged again and remains under the threat of punishment.
rows.anchor: من عاد إلى قتل الصيد محرما حكم عليه ثانيا، وهو بصدد الوعيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty and invincible, and takes vengeance on those who disobey Him.
rows.anchor: والله عزيز } منيع { ذو انتقام } من أهل معصيته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the audience does not answer who owns the heavens and earth, they are told that they belong to God.
rows.anchor: قل لمن ما في السموات والأرض } فإن أجابوك وإلا { قل لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's having prescribed mercy upon Himself is a gentle invitation to repent.
rows.anchor: أوجب على نفسه الرحمة، وهذا تلطف في الاستدعاء إلى الإنابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The emphatic oath means God will gather them to the Day they denied and bring them together with that Day.
rows.anchor: ليجمعنكم } أي: والله ليجمعنكم { إلى يوم القيامة } أي: ليضمنكم إلى هذا اليوم الذي أنكرتموه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who ruined themselves destroyed themselves through associating partners with God and therefore do not believe.
rows.anchor: الذين خسروا أنفسهم } أهلكوها بالشرك { فهم لا يؤمنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What dwells in or is contained by night and day means all created beings.
rows.anchor: ما حل فيهما، واشتملا عليه. يعني: جميع المخلوقات.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent messengers to earlier communities, who disbelieved them.
rows.anchor: ولقد أرسلنا إلى أمم من قبلك } رسلا فكفروا بهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ba'sa means severe poverty, while ḍarrāʾ means pains and illnesses.
rows.anchor: فأخذناهم بالبأساء } وهو شدة الفقر { والضراء } الأوجاع والأمراض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hardships were meant to make them humble themselves and become submissive.
rows.anchor: لعلهم يتضرعون } لكي يتذللوا ويتخشعوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question means they should have humbled themselves when punishment came, but they did not.
rows.anchor: فلولا } فهلا { إذ جاءهم بأسنا } عذابنا { تضرعوا } تذللوا، والمعنى: لم يتضرعوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hearts hardened, so they persisted in disbelief, and Satan adorned their misguidance for them.
rows.anchor: قست قلوبهم } فأقاموا على كفرهم { وزين لهم الشيطان } الضلالة التي هم عليها، فأصروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They forgot the warning by abandoning the admonition they had received.
rows.anchor: تركوا ما وعظوا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After hardship, God opened every door of favor and pleasure to them.
rows.anchor: من النعمة والسرور بعد الضر الذي كانوا فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God seized them suddenly while they were joyful so their regret would be more intense, leaving them despairing of all good.
rows.anchor: حتى إذا فرحوا بما أوتوا أخذناهم } في حال فرحهم؛ ليكون أشد لتحسرهم { بغتة فإذا هم مبلسون } آيسون من كل خير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dābir means the remainder at the end of a people; they were completely destroyed with no survivors.
rows.anchor: غابرهم الذي يتخلف في آخر القوم، والمعنى: استؤصلوا بالهلاك فلم يبق منهم باقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise is due to God for aiding the messengers and destroying wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: على نصر الرسل، وإهلاك الظالمين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypothetical removal of hearing and sight and sealing of hearts means taking those faculties away entirely.
rows.anchor: قل أرأيتم إن أخذ الله سمعكم وأبصاركم } أي: أصمكم وأعماكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question asks what god besides Allah could restore what He had taken away.
rows.anchor: من إله غير الله يأتيكم به } أي: بما أخذ عنكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To vary the signs means to explain them in the Qur'an; they nevertheless turn away from what has become clear.
rows.anchor: انظر كيف نصرف } نبين لهم في القرآن { الآيات ثم هم يصدفون } يعرضون عما ظهر لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who make religion amusement are unbelievers who mock and play when God's signs are heard.
rows.anchor: يعني: الكفار الذين إذا سمعوا آيات الله استهزؤوا بها وتلاعبوا عند ذكرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Admonish them with the Qur'an so a soul is not surrendered to ruin and imprisoned in Hell without escape.
rows.anchor: تسلم للهلكة، وتحبس في جهنم فلا تقدر على التخلص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse means to warn sinners of the consequences of their deeds so they may fear and become pious.
rows.anchor: وذكرهم بالقرآن إسلام الجانين بجناياتهم لعلهم يخافون فيتقون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul offered as a ransom could give the whole world, but no ransom would be accepted.
rows.anchor: تفد كل فداء. يعني: تفد بالدنيا وما فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those seized by their deeds are surrendered to ruin, and their drink is boiling water.
rows.anchor: الذين أبسلوا بما كسبوا } أسلموا للهلاك { لهم شراب من حميم } وهو الماء الحار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping idols is irrational because they are inanimate and can neither benefit nor harm.
rows.anchor: أنعبد ما لا يملك لنا نفعا ولا ضرا؛ لأنه جماد؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning back on one's heels means returning to shirk after God has guided one.
rows.anchor: نرد وراءنا إلى الشرك بالله، فيكون حالنا كحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The comparison is to a bewildered person lured by devils or ghouls into a wasteland, unable to find the path.
rows.anchor: استغوته واستفزته الغيلان في المهامة { حيران } مترددا لا يهتدي إلى المحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lost traveler has companions calling him back to guidance, yet he follows the devil that led him astray; this depicts one who strays after guidance.
rows.anchor: هذا مثل من ضل بعد الهدى، يجيب الشيطان الذي يستهويه في المفازة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's guidance alone is true guidance, answering those who call to worship idols.
rows.anchor: رد على من دعا إلى عبادة الأصنام، أي: لا نفعل ذلك؛ لأن هدى الله هو الهدى لا هدى غيره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As God showed Abraham the ugliness of his father's idol worship, He showed him the dominion of the heavens and earth.
rows.anchor: أي: وكما أرينا إبراهيم استقباح ما كان عليه أبوه من عبادة الأصنام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dominion includes the sun, moon, stars, mountains, trees, and seas.
rows.anchor: يعني: ملكهما، كالشمس، والقمر، والنجوم، والجبال، والشجر، والبحار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God showed Abraham these things so he could reflect and infer their Creator.
rows.anchor: أراه الله تعالى هذه الأشياء حتى نظر إليها معتبرا مستدلا بها على خالقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about becoming one of the certain is grammatically coordinated with the sense: to infer from the signs and thereby become certain.
rows.anchor: عطف على المعنى. تقديره: ليستدل بها وليكون من الموقنين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night covering Abraham means that it darkened.
rows.anchor: أي: ستر وأظلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's statement that the star was his lord voices what star-governance believers claimed; his people thought stars governed creation.
rows.anchor: أي: في زعمكم أيها القائلون بحكم النجم، وذلك أنهم كانوا أصحاب نجوم يرون التدبير في الخليقة لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By observing that the star set, Abraham exposed their error: something that disappears after appearing is originated and subjugated, not a lord.
rows.anchor: عرفهم جهلهم وخطأهم في تعظيم النجوم، ودل على أن من غاب بعد الظهور كان حادثا مسخرا، وليس برب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon's rising gave Abraham the same argument he had made against the star, and he used it for the sun as well.
rows.anchor: فاحتج عليهم في القمر والشمس بمثل ما احتج به عليهم في الكوكب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's plea for guidance means asking God to keep him firm upon guidance.
rows.anchor: أي: لئن لم يثبتني على الهدى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine demonstrative for the sun is used because the word for sun is masculine and because it carries the sense of brightness and light.
rows.anchor: ولم يقل هذه؛ لأن لفظ الشمس مذكر، ولأن الشمس بمعنى الضياء والنور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun is called greater than both the star and the moon.
rows.anchor: هذا أكبر } أي: من الكوكب والقمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once the proof was clear to his people, Abraham disavowed what they associated with God.
rows.anchor: فلما توجهت الحجة على قومه قال: { إني بريء مما تشركون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning his face means directing his worship and affirmation of God's oneness to God.
rows.anchor: أي: جعلت قصدي بعبادتي وتوحيدي لله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The remainder of the verse is explained in the earlier discussion.
rows.anchor: وباقي الآية مفسر فيما مضى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prophets named here were favored over the worlds of their own times.
rows.anchor: أي: من المذكورين ها هنا { فضلنا على العالمين } عالمي زمانهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some of their ancestors, descendants, and brothers were guided; min is partitive here.
rows.anchor: أي: وهدينا بعض آبائهم { وذرياتهم وإخوانهم } ف " من " ها هنا للتبعيض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their religion is God's guidance, by which He directs whichever servants He wills.
rows.anchor: دين الله الذي هم عليه { يهدي به من يشاء } يريد: يرشد إليه من يشاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had the guided prophets associated partners with God, their deeds would have been nullified.
rows.anchor: ولو أشركوا } عبدوا غيري { لحبط } بطل عملهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The book means the scriptures revealed to the prophets, and wisdom means knowledge and understanding of religion.
rows.anchor: أولئك الذين آتيناهم الكتاب } يعني: الكتب التي أنزلها عليهم { والحكم } العلم والفقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the Meccans disbelieve in God's signs, He has entrusted them to the emigrants and Helpers whom He guided to them.
rows.anchor: فإن يكفر بها } أي: بآياتنا { هؤلاء } أهل مكة { فقد وكلنا بها } أي: أرصدنا لها { قوما } وفقناهم لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those guided by God are the prophets mentioned earlier; following their guidance means enduring rejection patiently as they did.
rows.anchor: أولئك الذين هدى الله } يعني: النبيين الذين تقدم ذكرهم { فبهداهم اقتده } أي: اصبر كما صبروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet asks no payment for the Qur'an or conveying the message; it is an admonition for all creation.
rows.anchor: قل لا أسألكم عليه } على القرآن وتبليغ الرسالة { أجرا } مالا تعطونيه { إن هو } يعني: القرآن { إلا ذكرى للعالمين } موعظة للخلق أجمعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Meat over which God's name was mentioned means an animal ritually slaughtered in God's name.
rows.anchor: أي: مما ذكي على اسم الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Belief in God's signs confirms the lawfulness of what the law permits and further emphasizes permission for animals slaughtered in God's name.
rows.anchor: تأكيد لاستحلال ما أباحه الشرع ثم أبلغ في إباحة ما ذبح على اسم الله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has detailed the prohibitions, including the prohibition beginning with carrion.
rows.anchor: وقد فصل } بين { لكم ما حرم عليكم } في قوله:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Necessity permits eating what would otherwise be unlawful when circumstances compel it.
rows.anchor: دعتكم الضرورة إلى أكله مما لا يحل عند الاختيار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who permit carrion and debate its permissibility mislead many through desire, without knowledge or insight.
rows.anchor: وإن كثيرا ليضلون بأهوائهم } أي: الذين يحلون الميتة، ويناظرونكم في إحلالها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Transgressors are those who go beyond the lawful into the forbidden.
rows.anchor: المتجاوزين الحلال إلى الحرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outward and inward sin means sin in public and in secret; sinners will be repaid for what they commit.
rows.anchor: وذروا ظاهر الإثم وباطنه } سره وعلانيته، ثم أوعد بالجزاء فقال: { إن الذين يكسبون الإثم سيجزون بما كانوا يقترفون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What was not named over is meat from an animal that was not ritually slaughtered and died.
rows.anchor: مما لم يذك ومات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating that meat is fisq, a departure from the truth.
rows.anchor: وإنه } وإن أكله { لفسق } خروج عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan and his troops whisper to their polytheist allies to dispute with Muhammad and his companions over carrion.
rows.anchor: وإن الشياطين } يعني: إبليس وجنوده وسوسوا { إلى أوليائهم } من المشركين ليخاصموا محمدا وأصحابه في أكل الميتة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Obeying the allies by declaring carrion lawful amounts to shirk, since whoever permits what God forbade is an associator.
rows.anchor: وإن أطعتموهم } في استحلال الميتة { إنكم لمشركون } لأن من أحل شيئا مما حرمه الله فهو مشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A believer who performs a good deed receives tenfold, recorded as ten good deeds.
rows.anchor: من جاء بالحسنة } من عمل من المؤمنين حسنة { فله عشر أمثالها } كتبت له عشر حسنات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A sin receives only its equivalent recompense, so the sinner is not wronged by any reduction in reward.
rows.anchor: ومن جاء بالسيئة } الخطيئة { فلا يجزى إلا مثلها } أي: جزاء مثلها لا يكون أكثر منها { وهم لا يظلمون } لا ينقص ثواب أعمالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's guidance to a straight path and upright religion means that He taught the Prophet a religion.
rows.anchor: قل إنني هداني ربي إلى صراط مستقيم دينا } أي: عرفني دينا { قيما } مستقيما.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nusuk means worship, including pilgrimage and sacrifice.
rows.anchor: عبادتي من حجي وقرباني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives life and causes death.
rows.anchor: هو يحييني وهو يميتني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet directs prayer and all rites to God alone, not to anyone else.
rows.anchor: وأنا أتوجه بصلاتي وسائر المناسك إلى الله، لا إلى غيره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The extra la in the question is redundant: it asks what prevented Iblis from prostrating, as a rebuke.
rows.anchor: قال ما منعك إلا تسجد } " لا " زائدة. معناها: ما منعك أن تسجد؟! وهو سؤال التوبيخ والتعنيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis says he refused because fire made him superior to Adam, who was made of clay; he abandoned the command, reasoned by analogy, and disobeyed.
rows.anchor: منعني من السجود له أني خير منه إذ كنت ناريا، وكان طينيا، فترك الأمر وقاس، فعصى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God commanded Iblis to descend from the Garden.
rows.anchor: فانزل من الجنة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view takes the command to descend as referring to heaven.
rows.anchor: وقيل: من السماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis was not entitled to arrogance there through defying God's command.
rows.anchor: عن أمري وتعصيني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was ordered out among the abased because he left obedience.
rows.anchor: الأذلاء بترك الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis asked to be given respite until the second blowing of the Trumpet.
rows.anchor: قال انظرني } أمهلني { إلى يوم يبعثون } يريد: النفخة الثانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God granted Iblis the requested respite.
rows.anchor: إنك من المنظرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis's claim that God led him astray means that God caused him to go astray.
rows.anchor: يريد: فبما أضللتني، أي: بإغوائك إياي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis will sit across the straight path by making falsehood attractive to those who follow it toward Paradise.
rows.anchor: على الطريق المستقيم الذي يسلكونه إلى الجنة، بأن أزين لهم الباطل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis attacks from before by raising doubts about the hereafter, from behind by enticing people with worldly life, from the right by confusing religion, and from the left by enticing them to sins.
rows.anchor: يعني: آخرتهم التي يردون عليها، فأشككهم فيها { ومن خلفهم } دنياهم التي يخلفونها، فأرغبهم فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of the heights recognize leading unbelievers in Hell by their marks and rebuke their reliance on wealth and arrogance toward worship.
rows.anchor: من أهل النار { يعرفونهم بسيماهم } من رؤساء المشركين فيقولون لهم: { ما أغنى عنكم جمعكم } المال واستكثاركم منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After Hell's people swear that the people of the heights will not enter, the angels ask whether these are those whom God would never admit to mercy, then tell the people of the heights to enter Paradise.
rows.anchor: ثم يقسم أصحاب النار أن أصحاب الأعراف داخلون معهم النار، فتقول الملائكة الذين حبسوا أصحاب الأعراف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The request for water or God's provision means food too, showing that Hell's people are hungry and thirsty.
rows.anchor: يعني: الطعام، وهذا يدل على جوعهم وعطشهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forbidding water and food to unbelievers is a prohibition of access, not a ritual or legal prohibition.
rows.anchor: تحريم منع [لا تحريم تعبد]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who treated their religion as amusement and play are the mockers and faction-takers.
rows.anchor: يعني: المستهزئين المقتسمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's forgetting them means leaving them in Hell as they neglected to work for this Day.
rows.anchor: فاليوم ننساهم } نتركهم في جهنم { كما نسوا لقاء يومهم هذا } كما تركوا العمل لهذا اليوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their neglect also consisted of rejecting God's signs and refusing to affirm them.
rows.anchor: وكما جحدوا بآياتنا ولم يصدقوها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Corruption on earth includes shirk, sins, and bloodshed, after God set it right by sending a messenger.
rows.anchor: ولا تفسدوا في الأرض } بالشرك والمعاصي وسفك الدماء { بعد } إصلاح الله إياها ببعث الرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling on God with fear means fearing His punishment, and with hope means seeking His reward.
rows.anchor: وادعوه خوفا } من عقابه { وطعما } في ثوابه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's mercy here means His reward, which is near to those who obey His commands.
rows.anchor: رحمة الله } ثواب الله { قريب من المحسنين } وهم الذين يطيعون الله فيما أمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase describing winds as nushuran means pleasant and gentle, from nashr in the sense of a pleasant scent.
rows.anchor: طيبة لينة، من النشر وهو الرائحة الطيبة.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes the winds as scattered in every direction, meaning dispersed.
rows.anchor: وقيل: متفرقة في كل جانب، بمعنى المنتشرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before God's mercy means before the rain; the winds lift clouds heavy with water and drive them to a land without vegetation.
rows.anchor: قدام مطره { حتى إذا أقلت } أي: حملت هذه الرياح { سحابا ثقالا } بما فيها من الماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sends down water in the dead land and brings out every kind of fruit through that water.
rows.anchor: فأنزلنا به } بذلك البلد { الماء فأخرجنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bringing the dead to life resembles reviving the dead land; the sign should prompt reflection on God's oneness and power to resurrect.
rows.anchor: نحيي الموتى مثل ذلك الإحياء الذي وصفناه في البلد الميت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses tells his people to seek God's help and endure their oppression; God gives the land to whichever servants He wills, raising hope that they will inherit Pharaoh's kingdom and wealth.
rows.anchor: إن الأرض لله يورثها من يشاء من عباده } أطمعهم موسى أن يعطيهم الله ملكهم ومالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good outcome for the Godfearing is Paradise.
rows.anchor: العاقبة للمتقين } أي: الجنة لمن اتقى.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation of the good outcome is victory and success.
rows.anchor: وقيل: النصر والظفر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Israelites say they were harmed by killing before Moses came with the message and by renewed killing and exhausting labor afterward.
rows.anchor: قالوا أوذينا } بالقتل الأول { من قبل أن تأتينا } بالرسالة { ومن بعد ما جئتنا } بإعادة القتل علينا، والإتعاب في العمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses hopes that God will destroy Pharaoh and his people, install the Israelites in the land, and then see how they act.
rows.anchor: يهلك عدوكم } فرعون وقومه { ويستخلفكم في الأرض } يملككم ما كان يملك فرعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God afflicted Pharaoh's people with drought years, affecting desert dwellers, and reduced the fruits for people in towns.
rows.anchor: بالجدوب لأهل البوادي { ونقص من الثمرات } لأهل القرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In prosperity, they claimed good fortune as their due by custom instead of recognizing God and giving thanks.
rows.anchor: إنا مستحقوه على العادة التي جرت لنا من النعمة، ولم يعلموا أنه من الله فيشكروا عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In adversity, they blamed Moses and his people as an evil omen, while their true omen was their disbelief in God.
rows.anchor: يتشاءموا { بموسى } وقومه، وقالوا: إنما أصابنا هذا الشر بشؤمهم { ألا إنما طائرهم عند الله } شؤمهم جاءهم بكفرهم بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When remorse came upon them, they regretted worshipping the calf and recognized that they had disobeyed God after Moses returned.
rows.anchor: ولما سقط في أيديهم } أي: ندموا على عبادتهم العجل { ورأوا أنهم قد ضلوا } قد ابتلوا بمعصية الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses returned angry and sorrowful because God had tested them; he condemned them for making the calf a god and disbelieving God.
rows.anchor: غضبان } عليهم { أسفا } حزينا؛ لأن الله تعالى فتنهم { قال بئس ما خلفتموني من بعدي } بئسما عملتم من بعدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks if they had hastened ahead of their Lord's appointed forty nights by making the calf; they assumed he had died when he did not return after thirty nights.
rows.anchor: أعجلتم أمر ربكم } أسبقتم باتخاذ العجل معياد ربكم؟ يعني: الأربعين ليلة، وذلك أنه كان قد وعدهم أن يأتيهم بعد ثلاثين ليلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses cast down the tablets that contained the Torah.
rows.anchor: وألقى الألواح } التي فيها التوراة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses seized Aaron by his forelock and hair, reproaching him for not following him to tell him what Israel had done; the point recalls the exchange in Ṭā Hā.
rows.anchor: بذؤابته وشعره { يجره إليه } إنكارا عليه إذ لم يلحقه فيعرفه ما فعل بنو إسرائيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aaron explains that he stayed because the people overpowered him and nearly killed him.
rows.anchor: قال ابن أم } وكان أخاه لأبيه وأمه، ولكنه قال: يا ابن أم ليرققه عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though they shared both parents, Aaron said son of my mother to soften Moses toward him.
rows.anchor: وكان أخاه لأبيه وأمه، ولكنه قال: يا ابن أم ليرققه عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aaron asks Moses not to let the calf worshippers rejoice over him by striking or humiliating him, or count him among the wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: فلا تشمت بي الأعداء } يعني: أصحاب العجل بضربي وإهانتي { ولا تجعلني } في موجدتك وعقوبتك لي { مع القوم الظالمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses learned Aaron was innocent of blame because Aaron had protested so strongly that he feared being killed.
rows.anchor: إذا بلغ من إنكاره على عبدة العجل ما خاف على نفسه القتل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks forgiveness for what he did to Aaron and for Aaron if he fell short in objecting.
rows.anchor: قال رب اغفر لي } ما صنعت إلى أخي { ولأخي } إن قصر في الإنكار { وأدخلنا في رحمتك } جنتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being admitted into God's mercy means entering His Garden.
rows.anchor: وأدخلنا في رحمتك } جنتك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who took the calf are Jews contemporary with Muhammad, descendants of the calf worshippers; the descendants are censured by attribution of their ancestors' act to them.
rows.anchor: يعني: اليهند الذين كانوا في عصر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، وهم أبناء الذين اتخذوا العجل إلها، فأضيف إليهم تعييرا لهم بفعل آبائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will face God's anger as punishment in the afterlife and worldly humiliation through the jizya.
rows.anchor: عذاب في الآخرة { وذلة في الحياة الدنيا } وهي الجزية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God likewise punishes fabricators who adopt a god besides Him.
rows.anchor: وكذلك نجزي المفترين } كذلك أعاقب من اتخذ إلها دوني.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The evil deeds are shirk; repentance means turning from it and believing that no deity exists besides God, after which God is forgiving and merciful.
rows.anchor: السيئات } الشرك { ثم تابوا } رجعوا عنها { وآمنوا } صدقوا أنه لا إله غيري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Moses' anger subsided, he took back the tablets he had thrown down; their writing contained guidance from error and mercy from punishment for those who fear God.
rows.anchor: ولما سكت } [سكن] { عن موسى الغضب أخذ الألواح } التي كان ألقاها { وفي نسختها } وفيما كتب فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God ordered Moses to bring Israelites to apologize for worshipping the calf, so Moses selected seventy men for the appointed meeting.
rows.anchor: أمره الله تعالى أن يأتيه في ناس من بي إسرائيل يعتذرون إليه من عبادة العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After hearing God's speech, the seventy asked Moses to show them God openly; the violent shaking killed them all.
rows.anchor: فلما سمعوا كلام الله قالوا لموسى: أرنا الله جهرة فأخذتهم { الرجفة } وهي الحركة الشديدة، فماتوا جميعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says God could have destroyed them and him before the journey, when Israel would have witnessed it and not suspected him; he initially thought they had died because their companions worshipped the calf.
rows.anchor: وكان بنو إسرائيل يعاينون ذلك ولا يتهمونني، ظن أنهم أهلكوا باتخاذ أصحابهم العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Despite Moses' question about the foolish ones' deed, the seventy were actually destroyed because they asked to see God.
rows.anchor: وإنما أهلكوا لمسألتهم الرؤية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fitna was God's test and trial: He let some be led astray and others remain protected, explaining the statement that He misguides and guides whom He wills.
rows.anchor: أي: تلك الفتنة التي وقع فيها السفهاء لم تكن إلا فتنتك، أي: اختبارك وابتلاؤك أضللت بها قوما فافتتنوا، وعصمت آخرين وهذا معنى قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks God to decree good for them in this life and, in the hereafter, accept their coming and send them back with forgiveness and mercy.
rows.anchor: واكتب لنا } أوجب لنا { في هذه الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة } أي: اقبل وفادتنا، وردنا بالمغفرة والرحمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hudna means that they repent and return to God.
rows.anchor: تبنا ورجعنا إليك بالتوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's punishment afflicts whomever He wills for even a minor sin.
rows.anchor: آخذ به من أشاء على الذنب اليسير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's mercy encompassed the pious and impious in this world, but in the hereafter it is reserved for believers.
rows.anchor: إن رحمته في الدنيا وسعت البر والفاجر، وهي في الآخرة للمؤمنين خاصة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Writing the mercy means decreeing it in the hereafter for those who fear God, identified here as Muhammad's community.
rows.anchor: فسأكتبها } فسأوجبها في الآخرة { للذين يتقون } يريد: أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving zakat means paying the due alms on one's wealth at its appointed time.
rows.anchor: صدقات الأموال عند محلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believing in God's signs means affirming what was revealed to Muhammad and the prophets.
rows.anchor: يصدقون بما أنزل على محمد والنبيين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God brought Adam's descendants out from one another's backs, generation by generation as children are born from parents, ultimately drawing them all from Adam's loins like particles.
rows.anchor: أخرج الله تعالى ذرية آدم بعضهم من ظهور بعض على نحو ما يتوالد الأبناء من الآباء، وجميع ذلك أخرجه من صلب آدم مثل الذر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God took their covenant that He is their Creator and they are created beings; they acknowledged and accepted it after being endowed with reason.
rows.anchor: وأخذ عليهم الميثاق أنه خالقهم، وأنهم مصنوعون، فاعترفوا بذلك وقبلوا ذلك بعد أن ركب فيهم عقولا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's testimony against them was His asking whether He was their Lord.
rows.anchor: وأشهدهم على أنفسهم ألست بربكم } أي: قال: ألست بربكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels' statement that they witnessed refers to witnessing the people's acknowledgment of God's lordship.
rows.anchor: قالوا بلى } فأقروا له بالربوبية، فقالت الملائكة عند ذلك { شهدنا } أي: على إقراركم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The covenant prevents people from claiming on Judgment Day that they were unaware of it, forgot it, or merely followed their fathers' shirk.
rows.anchor: تقولوا } لئلا [تقولوا، أي: لئلا] يقول الكفار { يوم القيامة إنا كنا عن هذا } الميثاق { غافلين } لم نحفظه ولم نذكره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will recall the covenant on Judgment Day and cannot deny it because the angels testify to it.
rows.anchor: ويذكرون الميثاق ذلك اليوم فلا يمكنهم الإنكار مع شهادة الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This verse reminds all morally responsible people of the covenant because it came through a messenger's miracle and thus stands in their minds as remembered.
rows.anchor: وهذه الآية تذكير لجميع المكلفين ذلك الميثاق؛ لأنها وردت على لسان صاحب المعجزة، فقامت في النفوس مقام ما هو على ذكر منها.
